# Success

Completion requires version 1.0 of the metadata schema, R package, and searchable registry. Deliverables will include three hardened adapters tested in Linux, macOS, and Windows CI; 5–10 indexed tutorials; and four example tutorials tested in CI, collectively covering all three adapters. We will publish three or four integration templates and at least one reusable validation workflow.

At least three external contributors will review the schema, adapters, or tutorials. The registry pilot will test nomination, review, and stale-entry procedures. We will document check results and reviewer feedback, track external submissions, and measure author effort, including whether assisted metadata drafting reduces manual work.

Future work could support additional engines and educational-catalog integrations. Multilingual metadata, richer accessibility checks, and instructor collections remain outside the funded scope.
